title: [BUG] /compact Fails on Resumed Near-Full Context Conversations Regardless of History Depth
body:
## Environment
- Platform (select one):
  - [ x] Anthropic API (MAX account)
- Claude CLI version: 0.2.107 (Claude Code)
- Operating System: Linux 6.12
- Terminal:  gnome-terminal

## Bug Description
***regardless of how many messages earlier you go back to*** /compact doesn't seem to work on resumed conversation that were stopped when very close to having context window entirely  filled.
author: tassa-yoniso-manasi-karoto
